notes.title: The third report on the work on the second episode of our visual novel "Zavod"
notes.content: [p]Factory report of the second episode No. 3 [/p][p]We haven't been in touch for a long time: work on the novel is progressing slowly, as it happens due to the various difficulties mentioned in this post.[/p][p] Architectural Design Bureau Report:[/p][p] Backgrounds – 40% [/p][p]The backgrounds remain in the working stage and have not moved off the ground. The artist provided rough renderings, but the final version of the art is not ready yet. The artist sometimes disappears and stops responding to messages, perhaps he has his own problems. We are waiting for information...[/p][p]Sprites – 0% [/p][p]The sprite part remains zero. It was decided to complete the CG art first, and then refine the character sprites. [/p][p]CG-art – 50% [/p][p]Most of the artwork for Thursday is ready; the process is moving smoothly to Friday. Only one artist is actively working despite being busy with projects other than the factory. Thanks to Acta est Fabula for finding time for the Zavod project despite her busy schedule.[/p][p]Software Department Report: [/p][p]The code is 0% The code is at zero. We are waiting for the text to be fully edited and completed before it is inserted into the novel. [/p][p]The report of the Bright Sun Music Club:[/p][p]Music – 80% [/p][p]As you may have noticed from previous publications, the main composer of the novel joined the army. We are currently looking for a replacement, but we have managed to reach an agreement with the band Past Day: they will add a couple of their own compositions to the novel. At the moment, there will be eleven new tracks in the new episode.[/p][p]Voice acting — 0% [/p][p]We are awaiting the final and approved text of the new episode. [/p][p]Report from the Archive No. 9 factory: [/p][p]Scenario — 100% [/p][p]The script for the second episode is completely ready and now needs editing and polishing.[/p][p]Editing — 10% [/p][p]The editing will be done by the same person who edited the first episode. [/p][p]English translation — 0% [/p][p]We have received a lucrative offer to translate the novel into Chinese; perhaps there will be Chinese readers and fans of the factory atmosphere! [/p][p]Join VK Donut and Boosty to get the latest behind-the-scenes development news. [/p][p]Thank you for your support and interest in our visual novel "Zavod"![/p]

notes.title: Start of development of episode 2 of the visual novel "Zavod"
notes.content:
We present you the first report on the work on the second episode of our visual novel "Zavod".
This is the beginning of a new series of reports for our readers and works.
Factory report 2 episode #1
Report from the "Architectural and design" bureau:
Backgrounds - 0%
In this episode, it is planned to add two new lanterns that will show places where the main character has not been before.
Sprites - 0%
After studying the feedback from players, we came to the conclusion that it is necessary to add more poses and emotions to the characters to make them more alive.
GK ​​- 0%
In the new episode, 12 more new CGs will be added
Report from the "Software Department":
Code - 0%
We are actively working on integrating Steam Cloud into our novel so that you can safely save your game data and continue the game on different devices without losing progress. Also in the new episode, we are going to add one mini-game that will provide greater immersion into the world of technical specialties, which will allow us to think about their originality in the game.
Report from the music club "Bright Sun":
Music - 10%
We will definitely add more music in the styles of Sovetwave and Sythwave.
Sounds - 0%
Voice acting - 0%
I really hope that our previous voice acting cast will agree to return to their videos to maintain a unified style of the characters.
Report from the factory "Archive No. 9":
Script -40%
The second episode will cover two game days - Thursday and Friday. We listen carefully to your feedback and significantly downplay the reflection of the main character, taking into account more feedback that affects the development of the plot. This will allow players to interact more with the character and take part in his development, unlike the first episode.

Thank you very much for your support and interest in our visual novel "Zavod"!
